Rashi on Shabbat 118b:10:1.english: I did not call my wife "my wife" - For even my mundane conversation has wisdom to be learned from it.

Rashi on Shabbat 118b:10:2.english: My wife, my home - For she is the mainstay of the home.

Rashi on Shabbat 118b:10:3.hebrew: ולשורי שדי - שהוא עיקר של שדה, דכתיב: "ורב תבואות בכח שור" (משלי י״ד:ד׳):
Rashi on Shabbat 118b:10:3.english: And my ox, my field - For it is the mainstay of the field, as it is written: "And much increase is by the strength of the ox" (Proverbs 14:4).

Rashi on Shabbat 118b:11:1.english: I did not look, etc. - Out of great modesty.

Rashi on Shabbat 118b:11:2.hebrew: והא אמרו לו כו' - וא"כ, לרבי יוסי נמי הוה ליה למיקרייה רבינו הקדוש:
Rashi on Shabbat 118b:11:2.english: And didn't they say to him, etc. - And if so, Rabbi Yosei too should have been called "our holy Rabbi."

Rashi on Shabbat 118b:11:3.english: Below his belt - From the belt and downward.

Rashi on Shabbat 118b:11:4.hebrew: לא ראו קורות כו' - כשפושט חלוקו, [פושטו] כמו שהוא לובשו דרך ראשו, ומכסה את עצמו תחלה משום צניעות בסדינו מתחת, ויושב במטתו:
Rashi on Shabbat 118b:11:4.english: The beams did not see, etc. - When he takes off his shirt, [he takes it off] just as he puts it on, over his head, and first covers himself out of modesty with his sheet underneath, and sits on his bed.

Rashi on Shabbat 118b:12:1.hebrew: לא אמרתי דבר וחזרתי לאחורי - שאם בא מי שאמרתי עליו דבר ושאל אם אמרתי כן עליו, לא חזרתי בי לאמר אינו כדבריו, לפי שמתחלה אמת אמרתי. וקסבר: כל מילתא דמתאמרא באפי מרה לית בה משום לישנא בישא, וכן מפרש במסכת ערכין (דף טו:):
Rashi on Shabbat 118b:12:1.english: I never said something and retreated - For if the one about whom I said something came and asked whether I had said such about him, I did not retract [it] to say, "It is not as he says," because from the outset I spoke the truth. And he holds [that] any matter said in the presence of its subject carries no [prohibition of] evil speech, and so it is explained in Tractate Arakhin (15b).

Rashi on Shabbat 118b:13:1.hebrew: דקיימתי מצות תפילין - שלא הלך ארבע אמות בלא תפילין, וכן לענין ציצית:
Rashi on Shabbat 118b:13:1.english: Because I fulfilled the mitzvah of tefillin - That he did not walk four cubits without tefillin, and similarly with regard to tzitzit.

Rashi on Shabbat 118b:14:1.hebrew: עד דרמיה - שתקנה, וזה לשון תליית ציצית, כדאמרינן בעלמא (תענית ד' כב.): לא רמי חוטי:
Rashi on Shabbat 118b:14:1.english: Until he placed it - That he repaired it. And this is the expression for hanging [i.e., attaching] ritual fringes, as we say elsewhere (Taanit 22a): "he does not attach strings."

Rashi on Shabbat 118b:14:2.english: Who has completed his tractate - [Meaning] that he studied it.

Rashi on Shabbat 118b:1:1.english: The inheritance of Jacob - and not the inheritance of Abraham or Isaac.

Rashi on Shabbat 118b:1:2.english: Through its length and its width - This land and no more.

Rashi on Shabbat 118b:2:1.english: A dish of beets - It is [considered] important.

Rashi on Shabbat 118b:2:2.english: Heads of garlic - They were prized by them.

Rashi on Shabbat 118b:2:3.english: Kasa deharsana - Small fish fried in the oil of their innards and in flour.

Rashi on Shabbat 118b:3:1.hebrew: דור אנוש - התחילו לעבוד ע"ז, דכתיב (בראשית ד׳:כ״ו) ״אז הוחל לקרוא״ וגו':
Rashi on Shabbat 118b:3:1.english: The generation of Enosh - [They] began to worship idolatry, as it is written (Genesis 4:26): “Then it was begun to call,” etc.

Rashi on Shabbat 118b:5:1.hebrew: הרי זה מחרף ומגדף - שנביאים הראשונים תיקנו לומר בפרקים לשבח והודיה, כדאמרינן בערבי פסחים (דף קיז.), וזה הקוראה תמיד בלא עתה, אינו אלא כמזמר שיר ומתלוצץ:
Rashi on Shabbat 118b:5:1.english: He is one who curses and blasphemes - For the early prophets instituted [that it] be recited at specific times for praise and thanksgiving, as we say in [Chapter] Arvei Pesachim (117a); and this [person] who recites it constantly, not in its [proper] time, is merely like one singing a song and mocking.

Rashi on Shabbat 118b:5:2.hebrew: פסוקי דזמרא - שני מזמורים של הילולים — הללו את ה' מן השמים, הללו אל בקדשו:
Rashi on Shabbat 118b:5:2.english: Verses of praise [pesukei dezimra] - Two psalms of praise — "Praise the Lord from the heavens" [Psalms 148], [and] "Praise God in His sanctuary" [Psalms 150].

Rashi on Shabbat 118b:6:1.hebrew: דמדומי חמה - כשהיא אדומה; שחרית — אחרי הנצה מיד היא אדומה, וערבית — סמוך לשקיעתה:
Rashi on Shabbat 118b:6:1.english: The reddening of the sun - When it is red: in the morning, immediately after its rising it is red, and in the evening, close to its setting.

Rashi on Shabbat 118b:6:2.english: With the sun - With its rising.

Rashi on Shabbat 118b:6:3.hebrew: ולפני ירח - קודם אור הירח, בעוד השמש לא שקעה:
Rashi on Shabbat 118b:6:3.english: And before the moon - Before the light of the moon, while the sun has not [yet] set.

Rashi on Shabbat 118b:7:1.english: Among those who die from intestinal disease - For they are afflicted with suffering and their sins are cleansed.

Rashi on Shabbat 118b:7:2.hebrew: ממכניסי שבת בטבריא - מפני שהיא עמוקה ומחשכת מבעוד יום, וסבורין שחשכה. וממוציאי שבת בצפורי, שיושבת בראש ההר, ובעוד כשהחמה שוקעת נראית שם אור גדול, ומאחרין לצאת:
Rashi on Shabbat 118b:7:2.english: Among those who bring in Shabbat in Tiberias - Because it is deep [in a valley] and grows dark while it is still day, and they think that it has [already] grown dark. And [among those who] bring Shabbat out in Tzippori, which sits at the top of the mountain, and even while the sun is setting, a great light is visible there, and they delay ending [Shabbat].

Rashi on Shabbat 118b:7:3.english: Among those who seat [others in] the study hall - Attendants who gather students every day to come.

Rashi on Shabbat 118b:7:4.english: From among those who cause [others] to stand - [Those] appointed at mealtime to say, "The time has come to stand up and eat."

Rashi on Shabbat 118b:8:1.hebrew: ממחלקי - לעניים צדקה, דאמרינן בבבא בתרא פ"ק (דף ח:): צדקה נגבית בשנים ומתחלקת בשלשה. והמחלקים אותה, עליהם לבדוק לפי הצריך לכל אחד ואחד, ופעמים שקרובין דעתם לרחם על זה ולחלוק יותר מן הצורך, שאומדין אותו בהרווחה ואומדין את חברו בצמצום:
Rashi on Shabbat 118b:8:1.english: Among the distributors - [of] charity to the poor, as we say in Bava Batra, the first chapter (8b): "Charity is collected by two [people] and distributed by three." Those who distribute it must examine [each case] according to what is needed for each and every one; and sometimes they are inclined to have mercy on this one and distribute [to him] more than is needed, in that they assess him generously and assess his fellow sparingly.

Rashi on Shabbat 118b:9:1.hebrew: בעלתי ושניתי - כדי שיהיו זכרים, דאמר מר: הרוצה שיהיו בניו זכרים יבעול וישנה (עירובין דף ק:):
Rashi on Shabbat 118b:9:1.english: I engaged in relations and I did so again - So that they would be males, as the master said: One who wishes his children to be males should engage in relations and do so again (Eruvin 100b).

Tosafot on Shabbat 118b:12:1.hebrew: אילו היו אומרים לי חברי עלה לדוכן - לא ידע ר"י מה איסור יש בזר העולה לדוכן, אם לא משום ברכה לבטלה — של כהנים אמרה תורה לברך את ישראל:
Tosafot on Shabbat 118b:12:1.english: If my friends would say to me: Go up to the platform - R"i did not know what prohibition there is for a non-priest who goes up to the platform, if not on account of a blessing in vain — for [it is] to the priests [that] the Torah said to bless Israel.

Tosafot on Shabbat 118b:13:1.hebrew: עיון תפלה - פי' בכוונת הלב, וכן ההיא ד"אלו דברים שאוכל מפירותיהן בעולם הזה" (לקמן שבת דף קכז.) דחשיב עיון תפלה. אבל הא דאמר בברכות (דף לב: ונה.): "המעיין בתפלתו סוף בא לידי כאב לב" — ההוא עיון דמצפה מתי יעשה הקב"ה בקשתו, שסבור שתפלתו מקובלת, כדמייתי עלה "תוחלת ממושכה מחלה לב". וכן ההיא דאמר ר"י: "שלשה דברים מזכירין עוונותיו של אדם: קיר נטוי, ועיון תפלה, [ומוסר דין לשמים על חבירו]". והא דאמר בפרק גט פשוט (ב"ב קסד:): "שלשה דברים אין אדם ניצול מהם בכל יום: לשון הרע, והרהור עבירה, ועיון תפלה" — אין לפרש שמצפה מתי תיעשה בקשתו, שהרבה בני אדם ניצולים מזה; אלא הוה כי ההוא דשמעתין, כלומר: שאינו מתכוין בתפלה, שאי אפשר ליזהר, כדאמרינן בירושלמי: "מחזיקנא טיבו לרישא, דכי מטא למודים מנפשיה כרע":
Tosafot on Shabbat 118b:13:1.english: Consideration [during] prayer - Explanation: with concentration of the heart, and similarly that [teaching] of "These are the things whose fruits a person eats in this world" (later in Shabbat, 127a), where it counts "consideration [during] prayer." However, that which is stated in Berakhot (32b and 55a): "One who scrutinizes his prayer will ultimately come to heartache" — that [refers to] scrutinizing [in the sense] that he expects when the Holy One, blessed be He, will fulfill his request, for he thinks that his prayer is [certainly] accepted, as [the Gemara] cites upon it: "Hope deferred makes the heart sick" [Proverbs 13:12]. And similarly that which R. Yitzchak said: "Three things cause a person's sins to be recalled: a leaning wall, scrutinizing prayer, [and one who hands over judgment to Heaven against his fellow]." And [as for] that which is stated in the chapter [entitled] Get Pashut (Bava Batra 164b): "Three things a person is not spared from every day: evil speech, sinful thought, and consideration [during] prayer" — one should not explain [this] as [meaning] that he expects when his request will be fulfilled, for many people are spared from that; rather, it is like that of our passage, that is to say, that he does not concentrate in prayer, for it is impossible to be [completely] careful [about this], as we say in the Yerushalmi: "I am grateful to my head, for when it reaches Modim, it bows on its own":

Tosafot on Shabbat 118b:7:1.hebrew: רובם של צדיקים מתים בחולי מעיים - פי' בקונטרס למרק עונותיהם, ור"י אומר כי יש במדרש: למרק אכילה מן המעיים, להיות נקיים וטהורים כמלאכי השרת:
Tosafot on Shabbat 118b:7:1.english: "Most righteous people die of intestinal disease" - [Rashi] explained in the Kunteres [that it is] to cleanse their sins, and Ri says that there is [a teaching] in the Midrash [that it is] to cleanse food from the intestines, [so as] to be clean and pure like the ministering angels.

Tosafot on Shabbat 118b:9:1.hebrew: אימא ה' בעילות בעלתי ושניתי - ובירושלמי משני דיבמות היו, ולא רצה לקיים בהן מצות עונה, אלא רק כדי לקיים מצות יבום, דהיינו ביאה ראשונה:
Tosafot on Shabbat 118b:9:1.english: "Say: I engaged in relations five times and I did so again" - And in the Jerusalem Talmud, [the Gemara] answers that they were yevamot [sisters-in-law awaiting levirate marriage], and he did not want to fulfill the mitzva of conjugal rights with them, but rather only to fulfill the mitzva of levirate marriage, which is the first act of intercourse.
